criteria.requirement: Add Table.insert_iter and update_iter for one-shot iterable mapping records, with positive non-bool chunk_size, ensure/types and explicit atomic:boolean. Buffer/copy at most one chunk and call real insert_many/update_many exactly once per chunk, allowing late new columns per original schema policy and preserving the accepted absent-field update behavior. Return consumed record count, not affected rows. Empty input creates no table, invalid options do not consume input, source/generator errors propagate. atomic=True wraps the entire DML in the existing Database transaction; default keeps committed chunks on later failure. Document backend DDL rollback limitations; original Sequence APIs stay unchanged.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
